en.title: Learning to mend instead of replace
en.excerpt: A winter coat, a needle, and a small argument with convenience.
en.content:
A winter coat, a needle, and a small argument with convenience. The elbow had worn through in a way that looked intentional, as if the fabric had simply decided it was done.

I sat with the coat across my lap and considered buying a new one. It would have been faster. Instead I threaded the needle and began.

Mending is slow work. That is the point.
en.author: June Marsk
